the development of a semi-analytical method for determining the pressure and stress distributions on the contact surfaces of spur gears.
the development of new tools for the design of gears with modified flanks to avoid edge effects.

the SAM-C procedure is able to predict accurately the stresses state in gears with longitudinal crown and end relief.
the end edge effect can be avoided by a proper design of the flank modification.
the flank modification of spur gears can be a very efficient method to avoid the edge effect and to improve the RCF resistance.

the end relief is a suitable way to avoid the end effects and to obtain an uniform distribution of contact pressures.

the edge effect can be avoided by the appropriate modification of the gear tooth profile.
